productslides.notes: Stress the battery: we get many reports of Elite batteries that break down or stop charging. The quotes are from bol.com reviews. In reviews the most common topic is the shave itself: it pulls hairs instead of cutting them.
Our biggest volume: 25,627 units. Return rate is low, but critical reviews keep saying the blade does not catch the hairs.
Pro 8188: battery and charging is the top complaint. Supreme 8988: few complaints, mostly about an uneven trim.
Head Shaver Deluxe: battery and charging port. Blade Baron: few reviews, but the highest return rate of these products.
Groom Guard: the charging stand tips over. Flex Guard: pulls hairs, attachments do not match the description.
